{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:04.523

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:08.503

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:20.083

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:28.342
    | text      = because his version is better, and you should submit to it for your own good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:32.623

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
